note: The electrolyte model (GAME_SPEC §10): Pitzer's equations at 25 C, used at every temperature. a_phi and b: the Debye-Huckel term. pairs: a cation and an anion, named as in species.json's ions, with beta0, beta1, beta2, c_phi and the exponents alpha1, alpha2. A pair not listed has no specific interaction. diffusion: each ion's diffusion coefficient at 25 C, scaled to other temperatures as T / viscosity (GAME_SPEC §7); an ion not listed puts no limit on transport. viscosity: the solvent's (water's, at 0.5 MPa: the liquid to 150 C), mPa s, by rising temperature; read between points in its logarithm, held beyond the ends. water_ionisation: water's own ionisation, whose constant Kw sets the pH where neither an acid nor a base is left over. Sources: docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.

diffusion.note: each ion's diffusion coefficient in water at infinite dilution, 25 C, m2/s (GAME_SPEC §7)

pairs.source: Pitzer and Mayorga 1974; their c_phi, -0.0012, left out: beyond 65 mol/kg it turns the water's activity back up
Pitzer and Mayorga 1973, Table I (to 6 mol/kg)
Pitzer and Mayorga 1973, Table VI (to 4 mol/kg): their (4/3) beta0 0.0261, (4/3) beta1 1.484, (2^(5/2)/3) c_phi 0.00938

water_ionisation.note: H2O(l) -> H+(aq) + OH-(aq) at 25 C (GAME_SPEC §9, Stage 43): its enthalpy and Gibbs energy, kJ/mol, and its change of heat capacity, J/mol K, held at every temperature; Kw from them
